newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek M3 rises provisionally 9.5 pct y/y in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Greek M3 rises provisionally 9.5 pct y/y in Aug.

text.p: August Greek M3 money supply grew a provisional 9.5 percent year-on-year from a revised 7.2 percent in July, overshooting the central bank's 6.0-9.0 percent target range for end-96, the Bank of Greece said in a statement.

The acceleration of M3 growth was due to technical reasons, namely the issue of T-bills on September 2 instead of August 31, which was a holiday, and the recorded small surplus in the basic balance of payments, it said.
The M4 monetary aggregate grew provisionally 6.7 percent year-on-year in August after a revised 5.9 percent rise in July, it said.
